import datetime as dt
import pathlib
import random
from pathlib import Path

Path("state.json").read_text()
path: Path
path.write_text("state")
open("state.json")

make_rng = random.Random
rng = make_rng()
rng.seed(None)

parse_local_time = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp
parse_local_time(0)
value: dt.datetime
value.astimezone()

path_factory = pathlib.Path
other_path = path_factory("other.json")
other_path.unlink()
other_path.absolute()
other_path.expanduser()


class Box:
    pass


box = Box()
box.make_rng = random.Random
box.make_rng()
box.make_path = pathlib.Path
box.make_path("attribute.json").read_text()
box.parse_time = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp
box.parse_time(0)
box.path = pathlib.Path("stored.json")
box.path.exists()
